errors.text_span: The horizontal axis displays categories labeled Tier-1, Tier-2, Tier-3, and additional unlabeled categories, ordered alphabetically.
errors.evidence: The horizontal axis has no labels at all. The terms 'Tier-1', 'Tier-2', 'Tier-3' are from the paper's caption and describe ranges of values, not categories on the axis. The claim that they are ordered alphabetically is also false.

errors.text_span: with tick labels at 10-unit intervals
errors.evidence: The tick labels on the vertical axis are at 0, 20, 40, and 60, indicating a 20-unit interval, not 10.

errors.text_span: There are nine bars in total
errors.evidence: The chart contains twelve bars, not nine.

errors.text_span: each a shade of gray or blue
errors.evidence: The bars have a variety of colors beyond gray and blue, including green, purple, pink, and brown.

errors.text_span: The first bar, labeled Tier-1, is gray and extends to approximately 61.11%.
errors.evidence: The first bar is not labeled, its color is greenish-grey, and its value is 68.66, not 61.11.

errors.text_span: The second bar is blue and measures approximately 68.66%.
errors.evidence: The value of the second bar is 61.11, not 68.66.

errors.text_span: The third bar, labeled Tier-2, is gray and reaches 55.69%.
errors.evidence: The third bar is not labeled, its color is light blue, and its value is 29.44, not 55.69.

errors.text_span: The fifth bar, labeled Tier-3, is tan and measures approximately 36.62%.
errors.evidence: The fifth bar is not labeled, its color is a greyish-blue, and its value is 62.98, not 36.62. The description seems to be confusing the fifth bar with the sixth.

errors.text_span: The sixth bar has a value of 62.98%.
errors.evidence: The value of the sixth bar is 36.62, not 62.98.

errors.text_span: The eighth bar has a value of 55.30%.
errors.evidence: The value of the eighth bar is 55.69, not 55.30.

errors.text_span: The ninth bar has a value of 55.55%.
errors.evidence: The value of the ninth bar is 55.00, not 55.55.
The description stops after the ninth bar, omitting any mention of the tenth, eleventh, and twelfth bars, which have values of 55.30, 52.61, and 55.55, respectively.

errors.text_span: no annotations are present
errors.evidence: This is incorrect; every bar in the chart has its exact numerical value annotated directly above it.

errors.text_span: The horizontal axis displays categories labeled Tier-1 through Tier-3, presented in an ascending order.
errors.evidence: The horizontal axis has no labels. The description hallucinates labels ('Tier-1 through Tier-3') and an ordering ('ascending order') that are not present in the figure.

errors.text_span: with tick labels displayed at 10-unit intervals
errors.evidence: The tick labels on the vertical axis are at 20-unit intervals (0, 20, 40, 60), not 10.

errors.text_span: There are eight bars
errors.evidence: The chart clearly shows twelve bars, not eight.

errors.text_span: each representing a tier
errors.evidence: The bars are not labeled with tiers. This information is hallucinated, likely from outside context not visible in the chart itself.

errors.text_span: The first bar, representing Tier-1, is a dark gray color and extends to approximately 61.11%.
errors.evidence: The first bar is greenish-teal, not dark gray, and its value is 68.66%, not 61.11%.

errors.text_span: The second bar, also representing Tier-1, is a light teal and extends to approximately 68.66%.
errors.evidence: The second bar is purple, not light teal, and its value is 61.11%, not 68.66%. The values for the first two bars have been swapped.

errors.text_span: The third bar, representing Tier-2, is a light gray and extends to approximately 66.41%.
errors.evidence: The third bar is a light blue/teal color, not light gray, and its value is 29.44%, not 66.41%.

errors.text_span: The eighth bar, representing Tier-3, is a brown color and extends to approximately 29.44%.
errors.evidence: The eighth bar is a light lavender color, not brown, and its value is 55.69%, not 29.44%.
The description only describes 8 out of the 12 bars present in the chart, completely omitting the last four bars and their values (55.00, 55.30, 52.61, 55.55).
The description fails to mention a key feature of the chart: that the exact numerical value is printed on top of each bar.
